description: False-positive corpus for instruction-file integrity: realistic CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.local.md, rules and memory files, each with typical edits (append a line, or replace text). classify.test.ts fingerprints each file on a first run and then applies each edit as an out-of-band (unknown-writer) change.

files.name: ts-monorepo
files.content:
# Acme Web — monorepo

This is a pnpm workspace with three packages: `apps/web` (Next.js 15), `apps/api` (Fastify) and `packages/ui` (shared React components).

## Commands

- Install: `pnpm install` (Node 20, see `.nvmrc`; run `nvm use` first)
- Dev server: `pnpm dev --filter web`
- Type-check everything: `pnpm -r typecheck`
- Unit tests: `pnpm test` (Vitest); a single file: `pnpm vitest run path/to/file.test.ts`
- E2E: `pnpm --filter web exec playwright test`
- Lint and format: `pnpm lint` and `pnpm format`

## Conventions

- TypeScript strict mode everywhere; no `any` without a comment explaining why.
- React components are function components with named exports.
- Use `zod` schemas from `packages/schemas` for every API boundary.
- Prefer server components; mark client components with `"use client"` at the top.
- CSS: Tailwind only, no CSS modules in new code.

## Before committing

Run `pnpm lint && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm test`. CI runs the same three steps and fails the PR otherwise.

edits.append:
## Releases

Every user-visible change needs a changeset: `pnpm changeset`. Docs: https://github.com/changesets/changesets
If `pnpm` is missing, enable it with `corepack enable pnpm` (or `npm install -g pnpm@9`).

files.name: python-uv-service
files.content:
# billing-service

Python 3.12 service, managed with uv. FastAPI app in `src/billing/`, tests in `tests/`.

## Setup

Install uv with the standalone installer: `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh` (or `brew install uv`). Then:

```bash
uv sync
uv run pre-commit install
```

## Everyday commands

- Run the API locally: `uv run uvicorn billing.main:app --reload`
- Tests: `uv run pytest -q`
- One test: `uv run pytest tests/test_invoices.py::test_rounding -q`
- Lint: `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format .`
- Types: `uv run mypy src`

## Style

- Type hints on every public function.
- Money is always `Decimal`, never `float`.
- Database access goes through the repository classes in `src/billing/repo/`; no raw SQL in handlers.
- Keep functions under ~40 lines; split helpers out instead of nesting.

edits.append:
## Migrations

Create one with `uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m "message"` and apply it with `uv run alembic upgrade head`. See https://alembic.sqlalchemy.org/en/latest/tutorial.html

files.name: go-service
files.content:
# inventory-api (Go)

Go 1.23 module `github.com/acme/inventory-api`.

## Build and test

- `make build` builds `bin/inventory-api`
- `make test` runs `go test ./... -race -count=1`
- `make lint` runs golangci-lint (config in `.golangci.yml`)
- Generate mocks: `go generate ./...`

## Rules

- Errors are wrapped with `fmt.Errorf("context: %w", err)`; never log and return the same error.
- Context is the first parameter of every function that does I/O.
- Table-driven tests with `t.Run` subtests.
- No global state; dependencies are passed in through constructors.
- Keep handlers thin: decode, call the service, encode.

Docs for the HTTP router: https://pkg.go.dev/net/http#ServeMux

edits.append: Before committing, run `make lint test`.

files.name: rust-crate
files.content:
# fastjson-rs

A Rust crate (edition 2021, MSRV 1.75).

Install the toolchain with rustup if you do not have it: `curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh`.

## Commands

- `cargo build`
- `cargo test --all-features`
- `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo fmt --check`
- Benchmarks: `cargo bench --bench parse`

## Guidelines

- No `unsafe` outside `src/simd/`; every `unsafe` block has a `// SAFETY:` comment.
- Public items need doc comments with an example.
- Prefer `thiserror` for error enums.
- Keep the public API small; re-export from `lib.rs` only what users need.

edits.append: Run `cargo +nightly miri test` before touching `src/simd/`.
API guidelines we follow: https://rust-lang.github.io/api-guidelines/

files.name: nextjs-app

# marketing-site

Next.js 14 app router, deployed on Vercel.

- `npm ci` then `npm run dev`
- `npm run build` must pass before you open a PR

files.name: django-app
files.content:
# clinic-portal (Django)

Django 5 project. Python dependencies are pinned in `requirements/*.txt` and installed into a virtualenv.

## Setup

```
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements/dev.txt
python manage.py migrate
```

## Commands

- Run: `python manage.py runserver`
- Tests: `pytest` (uses `pytest-django`, settings `config.settings.test`)
- Lint: `ruff check .`
- New migration: `python manage.py makemigrations <app>`

## Conventions

- Business logic lives in `services.py` modules, not in views or models.
- Every view that touches patient data checks `request.user.has_perm(...)`.
- Never log patient names or dates of birth.
- Templates extend `base.html`; no inline scripts.

edits.append: Before committing, run `ruff check . && pytest -x`.
Django docs: https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/5.1/

files.name: rails-app
files.content:
# storefront (Rails 7)

- Ruby version is in `.ruby-version`; use `rbenv install` if it is missing.
- `bin/setup` installs gems, creates the database and seeds it.
- `bin/dev` starts Rails and the CSS/JS watchers.
- Tests: `bin/rails test` and `bin/rails test:system`.
- Lint: `bundle exec rubocop`.

Rules:
- Fat models are fine, but extract service objects once a method passes 20 lines.
- Use strong parameters in every controller.
- Background jobs go in `app/jobs` and must be idempotent.
- No N+1 queries: use `includes` and check the Bullet warnings in development.

edits.append: - Run `bundle exec rubocop -a` before committing.

files.name: terraform-infra
files.content:
# platform-infra

Terraform 1.9 for the AWS accounts. Modules in `modules/`, environments in `envs/{dev,staging,prod}`.

- Format: `terraform fmt -recursive`
- Validate: `terraform validate` in each env directory
- Plan: `make plan ENV=dev` (wraps `terraform plan` with the right backend config)

Conventions:
- Every resource gets the `owner` and `cost-center` tags from `local.common_tags`.
- No inline IAM policies; use `aws_iam_policy_document` data sources.
- Pin provider versions in `versions.tf`.
- Run `tflint` and `checkov -d .` before opening a PR.

edits.append: Module READMEs are generated with `terraform-docs markdown table --output-file README.md .`

Jupyter notebooks plus a small Python package in `churn/`.

files.name: node-cli
files.content:
# tidy-cli

A small Node.js CLI published to npm as `tidy-cli`.

## Development

- `npm install`
- `npm run build` (tsc to `dist/`)
- `npm test` (node:test)
- Try it locally: `node dist/cli.js --help` or `npm link` then `tidy --help`

## Guidelines

- No runtime dependencies beyond `commander` and `picocolors`.
- Every command has a `--json` flag for machine-readable output.
- Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 usage error, 2 runtime error.
- Keep `--help` text and README in sync.

edits.append: Release with `npm version patch && npm publish`; the `prepublishOnly` script runs the tests.
Users can run it without installing: `npx tidy-cli@latest check .`

files.name: spring-boot
files.content:
# orders-service (Spring Boot 3)

Java 21, Gradle Kotlin DSL.

- Build: `./gradlew build`
- Tests: `./gradlew test`; integration tests: `./gradlew integrationTest` (needs Docker for Testcontainers)
- Run: `./gradlew bootRun --args='--spring.profiles.active=local'`
- Format: `./gradlew spotlessApply`

Rules:
- Constructor injection only, no field injection.
- DTOs are Java records.
- Controllers return `ResponseEntity` and never expose JPA entities.
- Database changes go through Flyway migrations in `src/main/resources/db/migration`.

edits.append: Before committing, run `./gradlew spotlessApply test`.

files.name: android-kotlin
files.content:
# Habit tracker (Android)

Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, minSdk 26.

- Build debug: `./gradlew assembleDebug`
- Unit tests: `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest`
- Instrumented tests: `./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest`
- Lint: `./gradlew lintDebug ktlintCheck`

Architecture: MVVM with a repository layer. ViewModels expose `StateFlow`, never `LiveData` in new code.
Strings go in `res/values/strings.xml`; no hard-coded UI text.

files.name: ios-swift

files.name: cpp-cmake

# imaging-core

C++20 library, CMake + Ninja.

```
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
cmake --build build
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
```

- Follow the `.clang-format` file; run `clang-format -i` on changed files.

files.name: docs-site

- `yarn install`
- `yarn start` for a live preview at http://localhost:3000

Writing style:

Manifest V3, TypeScript, built with Vite.

files.name: ml-training
files.content:
# vision-train

PyTorch training code for the defect detector.

## Setup

We use uv for environments. Install it (`pip install uv` or the standalone installer from https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/), then run `uv sync --extra cuda`.

## Commands

- Train a small config: `uv run python -m vision_train.train --config configs/debug.yaml`
- Evaluate: `uv run python -m vision_train.eval --ckpt <path>`
- Tests: `uv run pytest`

## Notes

- Configs are YAML under `configs/`; never hard-code hyperparameters.
- Log metrics through `vision_train.logging`, which wraps Weights & Biases.
- Large checkpoints go to the shared bucket, not into git.

edits.append: - Set seeds with `vision_train.utils.seed_everything(cfg.seed)` at the start of every entry point.

files.name: dotnet-api
files.content:
# Payments.Api (.NET 8)

- `dotnet restore` then `dotnet build`
- `dotnet test` runs xUnit tests
- `dotnet format` before committing

Guidelines:
- Minimal APIs grouped by feature in `Features/`.
- Use `IOptions<T>` for configuration; no `Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable` in business code.
- Async all the way; no `.Result` or `.Wait()`.
- Nullable reference types are enabled; fix warnings rather than suppressing them.

edits.append: EF Core migrations: `dotnet ef migrations add <Name> -p src/Payments.Infrastructure`.

files.name: php-laravel
files.content:
# helpdesk (Laravel 11)

- `composer install` and `npm install`
- `php artisan migrate --seed`
- `php artisan serve` and `npm run dev`
- Tests: `php artisan test` (Pest)
- Static analysis: `vendor/bin/phpstan analyse`

Use Form Requests for validation, Policies for authorization, and Eloquent API resources for responses.

edits.append: Format PHP with `vendor/bin/pint` before committing.

files.name: security-rules
files.content:
# payments-gateway

Security-sensitive service. Read this before changing anything.

- Never commit `.env` files or anything under `secrets/`; they are gitignored for a reason.
- Never log card numbers, CVVs or full tokens; use `mask_pan()` from `gateway/redact.py`.
- Credentials come from the secret manager at runtime, never from source.
- All outbound HTTP calls go through `gateway/http.py`, which enforces TLS and timeouts.
- Dependency updates need a second reviewer.

Commands: `make test`, `make lint`, `make audit` (runs `pip-audit`).

edits.append: Threat model: https://wiki.acme.example/security/payments-gateway-threat-model

files.name: monorepo-nx
files.content:
# Acme platform (Nx)

- `npm ci`
- `npx nx affected -t lint test build` is what CI runs; run it locally before pushing
- Generate a library: `npx nx g @nx/js:lib libs/<name>`
- Graph: `npx nx graph`

Boundaries are enforced by `@nx/enforce-module-boundaries`; do not add `// eslint-disable` to get around them.

edits.append: If builds behave oddly, clear the cache with `npx nx reset`.

files.name: agents-ts-lib
files.content:
# AGENTS.md

## Setup commands

- Install deps: `pnpm install`
- Start dev server: `pnpm dev`
- Run tests: `pnpm test`

## Code style

- TypeScript strict mode
- Single quotes, no semicolons
- Use functional patterns where possible

## Testing instructions

- Find the CI plan in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
- From the package root you can just call `pnpm test`. The commit should pass all tests before you merge.
- Fix any test or type errors until the whole suite is green.
- Add or update tests for the code you change, even if nobody asked.

## PR instructions

- Title format: `[<project_name>] <Title>`
- Always run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` before committing.

edits.append: - To focus on one step, add the Vitest pattern: `pnpm vitest run -t "<test name>"`.

files.name: agents-python
files.content:
# Agent instructions

This repository is a Python 3.11 library (`src/geokit`).

- Create the environment: `uv venv && uv pip install -e ".[dev]"`
- Tests: `uv run pytest`
- Lint: `uv run ruff check src tests`
- Type check: `uv run pyright`

Keep the public API in `src/geokit/__init__.py` stable; deprecate before removing.
Write docstrings in NumPy style. Examples in docstrings are run by `pytest --doctest-modules`.

edits.append: Build the docs with `uv run mkdocs serve`; the site is published at https://geokit.readthedocs.io

files.name: agents-go
files.content:
# AGENTS.md

- Go 1.22. Run `go test ./...` before you finish.
- `golangci-lint run` must be clean.
- Do not add new dependencies without asking.
- Generated files (`*_gen.go`) are produced by `go generate`; do not edit them by hand.
- Integration tests need Postgres: `docker compose up -d db` then `go test -tags=integration ./...`.

edits.append: - Benchmarks: `go test -bench=. -benchmem ./internal/codec`.

files.name: agents-monorepo
files.content:
# Contributor and agent guide

## Layout

- `services/` — backend services (Kotlin, Gradle)
- `web/` — frontend (TypeScript, Vite)
- `infra/` — Terraform

## How to verify a change

1. `./gradlew :services:<name>:check` for backend changes.
2. `cd web && npm ci && npm run test -- --run` for frontend changes.
3. `cd infra && terraform fmt -check -recursive` for infra changes.

## Conventions

- Feature flags live in `services/flags/` and default to off.
- API changes need an entry in `docs/api-changelog.md`.
- Keep commits small and focused; one logical change per commit.

edits.append: Regenerate the API client after changing an endpoint: `npm run openapi:generate` in `web/`.

files.name: agents-rust
files.content:
# Notes for coding agents

- Toolchain pinned in `rust-toolchain.toml`.
- `cargo test --workspace` and `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` must pass.
- `cargo fmt --all` before committing.
- Prefer iterators over index loops; avoid `clone()` in hot paths.
- The `cli` crate may depend on `core`, never the other way around.

edits.append: - `cargo nextest run` is faster if you have it (`cargo install cargo-nextest`).

files.name: agents-mobile

# AGENTS.md — Flutter app

- `flutter pub get`
- `flutter test`
- `dart format .` and `flutter analyze`
- Golden tests: `flutter test --update-goldens` only when a visual change is intended.

State management: Riverpod. Routing: go_router. Keep widgets stateless where possible.

edits.append: Flutter style guide: https://docs.flutter.dev/perf/best-practices

files.name: agents-java

# Instructions for agents

Maven project, Java 17.

- Build and test: `mvn -q verify`
- Single test: `mvn -q -Dtest=OrderServiceTest test`
- Checkstyle runs in `verify`; fix violations instead of suppressing them.

Use AssertJ for assertions and Mockito for mocks. Never commit `target/`.

edits.append: Before committing, run `mvn -q verify`.

files.name: agents-infra
files.content:
# AGENTS.md (Ansible)

- Lint: `ansible-lint`
- Syntax check: `ansible-playbook site.yml --syntax-check`
- Molecule tests per role: `cd roles/<role> && molecule test`

Rules:
- Every task has a `name`.
- Use FQCNs (`ansible.builtin.copy`, not `copy`).
- Secrets come from Vault lookups; never put them in `group_vars`.

edits.append: Install collections with `ansible-galaxy collection install -r requirements.yml`.

files.name: local-prefs
files.content:
# My local notes

- My dev database is on port 5433, not 5432.
- I use `fish`; shell snippets should work in fish or say they are bash-only.
- Use the `staging` AWS profile for anything that needs credentials (`export AWS_PROFILE=staging`).

edits.append: - My sandbox is at http://localhost:8080/admin

files.name: local-prefs-2
files.content:
Personal preferences for this repo:
- Explain the plan before making large changes.
- Use `rg` instead of `grep -r`.
- I review PRs on GitHub; keep commit messages in the imperative mood.

edits.append: - Run only the tests for the package you changed unless I ask for the full suite.

files.name: user-global
files.content:
# Global preferences

- I work mostly in TypeScript and Python.
- Prefer small, reviewable diffs.
- Ask before adding a new dependency.
- When you are unsure about a requirement, ask instead of guessing.
- Use British spelling in prose, American spelling in code identifiers.

edits.append: - Never force-push to shared branches.
- My editor is Neovim; do not add VS Code-specific config files.

files.name: user-global-2
files.content:
## How I like to work

- Run the relevant tests after every change and show me the result.
- Don't write comments that restate the code.
- Use `pnpm` for JavaScript projects unless the repo already uses something else.
- For Python, use `uv run` to execute tools inside the project environment.

edits.append: - Node versions are managed with nvm (installed from https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm); run `nvm use` when a project has an `.nvmrc`.

files.name: rules-testing
files.content:
# Testing rules

- Every bug fix comes with a regression test that fails before the fix.
- Unit tests must not touch the network or the real filesystem; use the fixtures in `tests/fixtures/`.
- Name tests after behaviour: `it("rejects an expired token")`, not `it("works")`.
- Snapshot tests are allowed only for serialized output formats.

edits.append: - Keep each unit test under 200 ms; mark slower ones with `@slow`.

files.name: rules-api
files.content:
# API design

- REST resources are plural nouns: `/v1/invoices`, `/v1/invoices/{id}`.
- Use cursor pagination (`?cursor=…&limit=…`), never offset pagination for new endpoints.
- Errors follow RFC 9457 problem details.
- Every endpoint is documented in `openapi.yaml` before it is implemented.

edits.append: - Breaking changes need a new major version prefix (`/v2`).

files.name: memory-index
files.content:
# Memory index

- [User preferences](preferences.md) — prefers pnpm, small diffs, British spelling in docs
- [Project build](build.md) — how to build and test this repo
- [Deploy process](deploy.md) — staging first, prod via the release workflow

edits.append: - [Database notes](database.md) — local Postgres runs on port 5433

files.name: memory-preferences
files.content:
---
name: preferences
description: How the user likes to work
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  originSessionId: 3f0c2a4e-1b2c-4d5e-8f90-123456789abc
  modified: 2026-10-20T09:12:44.512Z
---

- Keep diffs small and explain the plan first for anything touching more than three files.

files.name: memory-deploy

name: deploy

files.name: memory-debugging
files.content:
---
name: debugging
description: Things learned while debugging this project
---

- Flaky test `checkout.spec.ts` fails when the mock clock is not reset; call `vi.useRealTimers()` in `afterEach`.
- The API returns 502 locally when the `auth` container is not running.
- `pnpm dev` needs `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096` on machines with little RAM.

edits.append: - Prisma client must be regenerated (`pnpm prisma generate`) after pulling schema changes.

files.name: memory-agent
files.content:
# Reviewer subagent memory

- This team wants review comments grouped by severity: blocking, should-fix, nit.
